rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/full blastocyst with visible blastocoel, plausible ICM cluster, and cohesive TE consistent with the provided 3AA grade; appropriately notes limits of a single static image. Minor uncertainty and limited detail on zona/collapse prevent a top score.
Strongly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI/lifestyle, male-factor diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, prior miscarriage, and low MII yield with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with probability estimates and recommendations generally supported by the case. Minor issues include some overinterpretation of the low MII yield and a small inconsistency in phrasing around implantation odds.

Largely consistent with Gardner grading, single embryo transfer in a young good-prognosis patient, and cautious stance on PGT-A. Slight overreach in suggesting broad miscarriage workup after only one prior clinical miscarriage lowers the score.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer, luteal support/follow-up, single embryo transfer, and future cycle planning including trigger/maturity review, uterine evaluation if needed, and selective male-factor testing.
